manual.assortedutil.chapter.auto_item_re: When the stack in your hand runs out or your tool breaks, a match from your inventory takes its place. A finished potion or stew is swapped for a full one.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.damage_numbe: Damage and healing pop off creatures as numbers, naming the weapon or creature that did it.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.double_doors: One click opens both doors of a pair, a trapdoor hatch, or a run of fence gates, modded ones too. Sneak to open just one.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.graves.info: Where you die, all you carried and all your experience go into a grave, and chat tells you where it is. Anything with Curse of Vanishing still vanishes.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.graves.resto: Use your grave to put everything back where it was, armour and all. Break it instead and it all spills out. Explosions, pistons and bosses cannot touch it.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.light_overla: Press F7 to see the block light wherever a monster could stand. Red spawns them at any time, yellow only in the dark, green never.
manual.assortedutil.chapter.time.info: Press H for the day and time in the world, again for your own date and time, again for both, and once more to put it away. The Nether keeps no time.
manual.assortedutil.description: Graves, double doors, an item replacer, a clock, a light level overlay and damage numbers.
manual.assortedutil.title: Assorted Util
message.assortedutil.grave.dug: Your belongings are in a grave at %s, %s, %s.
message.assortedutil.grave.no_room: There was no room for a grave, so your belongings were dropped.
